newsitem.title: USA: Duff says reviewing Conseco debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: Duff says reviewing Conseco debt ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it is reviewing Conseco Inc's senior debt rating of triple-B and preferred stock rating of double-B plus.

This follows Conseco's plan to buy American Travellers Corp for about $793 million and Capitol American Financial Corp for about $650 million. It also plans to acquire the shares it does not already own of American Life Holdings and Bankers Life Holding Corp.
Duff said it also is reviewing Bankers Life's senior subordinated debt rating of triple-B-minus.
Duff said the ratings are on "rating watch--developing," pending additional information on the transaction.
In addition Duff said it may raise the double-B-minus senior subordinated debt rating of American Life Holding. Duff has put those ratings on "rating watch--up."
"The ultimate ratings will be based on the terms of the transaction, management's strategic plans and due diligence to be performed on American Travellers and Capitol American," Duff said.
Duff said it is also reviewing the triple-B-minus senior subordinated debt ratings of Life Partners Group Inc LPG.N, which Conseco this month agreed to buy for $840 million.
